mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and teratogenic; isotretinoin is highly teratogenic (pregnancy category X) and sulfasalazine can impair folate metabolism and increase hepatic burden, compounding toxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, ensure strict contraception (isotretinoin requires iPLEDGE program), baseline and periodic liver function tests, and careful monitoring for hepatotoxicity and hematologic abnormalities.
